about: Answers with planted claims of known truth. 'question_title' must match a bank question exactly; 'contains' is a substring of the claim text the checker will report. Add cases when the dashboard shows a misconception the checker missed.

cases.question_title: Auto-commit or manual commit? Tell me about losing messages with auto-commit.
cases.answer: Auto-commit runs on a timer controlled by auto.commit.interval.ms, which is five seconds by default. Auto-commit only commits an offset after my processing code has finished successfully, so it can never lose a message. In production I prefer manual commit after the database write succeeds.

planted.contains: only commits an offset after my processing code has finished

cases.question_title: What does auto.offset.reset do? We started a new consumer group and it processed nothing.
cases.answer: The default value of auto.offset.reset is latest, so a brand-new group skips everything already in the topic. auto.offset.reset is applied every time the consumer starts, even when the group already has committed offsets. Setting it to earliest makes a group with no committed offset begin at the start of the partition.

planted.contains: default value of auto.offset.reset is latest
applied every time the consumer starts
earliest makes a group with no committed offset

cases.question_title: What is a consumer group, and what happens if I run more consumers than partitions?
cases.answer: Within a group each partition is assigned to at most one consumer. If I run more consumers than partitions, the extra consumers share partitions and process messages in parallel, which is how I scale beyond the partition count.

planted.contains: each partition is assigned to at most one consumer

cases.question_title: What is a rebalance, what triggers it, and what actually happens during one?
cases.answer: A rebalance only happens when a new consumer joins the group. A consumer that does not call poll within max.poll.interval.ms is removed from the group, which also triggers a rebalance.
